summary: Super Group (SGHC) Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held June 25, 2026. All 10 ordinary resolutions were approved, including receipt of annual report/audited financials, ratification of Deloitte as auditor, auditor remuneration, and reappointment of six directors. The filing also notes shareholder authorization for the company to make market purchases of up to 14.99% of its own shares, subject to price parameters. This is a routine annual meeting disclosure with no special-situation event such as an acquisition or activist campaign. The share buyback authorization is standard governance and does not represent an announced capital return program.
